Running it
----------
simcity.dsk is a disk image for a Toshiba Pasopia 7 (a 5.25 inch disk, one
side, 40 tracks).  Put it in the first drive and reset the machine (or
start the emulator with it in the first drive): it boots straight into the
game, with no BASIC or other disk needed.  Loading takes a few seconds.

The game uses the 320 x 200 screen in eight colours as a grid of 40 by 25
cells, using the SN76489 for the effects. Cities are saved to and loaded from 
the same disk, in one of five slots after the game itself (so the disk must
not be write protected, and the image file is changed when you save).  The
map is 96 x 96 squares and there are no scenarios.

This has been run in Takeda's EmuPIA7 and under a model of the machine; the
Z80 CTC the game takes its time from (the machine's beeper channels), the
keyboard and the disk timing on a real Pasopia 7 are untested.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (the up key with the shift
                  key is down)
  Q A O P         up, down, left, right (shifted: eight squares)
  Space           build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
